intelligence.human_view: Think of reading a book versus swimming down a river. Scrolling is the river — you keep swimming, hunting for the next thing, never sure where you are. The framed viewpoint is the book: one page, whole, in front of you, and then the next page comes to you. Every step of everything — a lesson, a message, a page of the agreement — arrives as its own frame, and you never have to chase it. You stop learning how each page works, because they all work the same way, and you just live in them.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine the page never makes you scroll down, down, down! Instead, each step comes to you in its own pretty frame! One frame, then the next frame, like turning pages in a picture book! You just sit still, and the story comes to you!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine you never have to scroll and scroll, dear, hunting down the page for the next thing! Instead, each step comes right to you, love, in its own lovely frame — one clean view, then the next one comes into view! One frame, then the next, dear, like turning the pages of a picture book! You just sit still, love, and the story comes to you!
intelligence.naya_view: Every area presents as frames. Each step is its own frame — visual and text alike — and the next frame comes INTO the viewpoint. No scrolling down, no scrolling across, anywhere. The agreement, visual + text, is a framed presentation (walkthrough fix-9). The membership site is framed lessons, frame by frame (the rebuild). Mail gets its framing round; Messenger gets its framing round after its one-item fix lands — same file, one round at a time. "Now we have our viewpoints. Our viewport."
